critique.change: Vary the tip on screen so V*R^2 is visible: make the oxblood tip thin and sharp in fast beats and blunt in slow ones, since shot-02s and shot-20s show the same tip shape.
Replace the overlapping blobby defect glyphs at shot-08s and shot-20s with separated, legible letters placed at one constant lag behind the tip, so the fixed-lag rule reads.
Add shading or a ridge highlight on each arm and side arm so the frame has more than one rendering layer, and fill the frame at shot-02s as the storyboard promises.
